సాయంత్రం వేడివేడి టీ తో పాటు తినడానికి బేకరీ స్టైల్ లో కరకరలాడే 'క్యాబేజీ పకోడి' (Cabbage Pakodi) ఇంట్లోనే చాలా సులువుగా ఎలా తయారు చేసుకోవాలో ఈ వీడియోలో చూడండి! నూనె అస్సలు పీల్చకుండా, బయట క్రిస్పీగా లోపల రుచిగా వచ్చే ఈ పకోడి పిల్లల నుండి పెద్దల వరకు అందరికీ బాగా నచ్చుతుంది.
​ఈ సింపుల్ అండ్ టేస్టీ స్నాక్ రెసిపీ మీరు కూడా ఇంట్లో తప్పకుండా ట్రై చేయండి. వీడియో మీకు నచ్చితే లైక్ చేసి, మీ ఫ్రెండ్స్ అండ్ ఫ్యామిలీతో షేర్ చేయండి. మరిన్ని రుచికరమైన వంటల కోసం ఛానెల్‌ను సబ్‌స్క్రైబ్ చేసుకోండి!#CabbagePakodi #CrispyPakora #EveningSnacks #TeluguVantalu #TeaTimeSnacks #StreetStylePakodi #CabbageRecipes #TeluguShorts #FoodReels #AromaTeluguFlavours #MiddleClass1976 #NagalaxmiVantalu #CookingInTelugu

snippet.description:
In this UPSC Prelims Strategy Session, AIR 100, UPSC CSE 2025, shares insights from his six attempts in the Civil Services Examination, during which he cleared Prelims in all six attempts before securing his final rank.

📥 Download the 90-Day UPSC Prelims Study Planner (With Daily Targets): https://shorturl.at/QLPSH

Explore Prelims Master Program (PMP) 2027: https://shorturl.at/0CvP0

Book a Free 1:1 Mentorship Session: https://www.levelupias.com/free-1-1-mentorship-session/


Drawing from his personal experience, he explains how aspirants can develop a structured approach to the UPSC Prelims examination and avoid common mistakes.

Key topics covered in this session:
- The Three-Round Strategy: How to divide questions into sure-shot, 50-50 and difficult questions.
- Question Selection: How to identify questions worth attempting and those better left unanswered.
- Time Management: How to manage lengthy questions and complete the paper efficiently.
- Attempt Count: How to determine your ideal number of attempts based on accuracy and mock-test performance.
- Accuracy & Confidence: How to evaluate whether your confidence in an answer is actually justified.
- Elimination Techniques: How to use conceptual understanding and logical deduction instead of blind guessing.
- Mock Test Analysis: How to analyse your performance and build an exam-day strategy.
- Prelims Preparation: The importance of subject foundations, revision notes and consistent practice.

The session also discusses how to approach different types of UPSC Prelims questions through actual PYQ examples, including questions from UPSC Prelims 2025.

Whether you are a beginner or a repeat aspirant preparing for UPSC CSE 2027, this session offers practical insights into improving your Prelims preparation and developing a personalised examination strategy.

Watch the complete session and start building your Prelims strategy!

#UPSC2027 #UPSCPrelims2027 #UPSCPrelimsStrategy #PrelimsPreparation #UPSCStrategy #AIR100 #UPSC2025 #LevelUpIAS
